'''Frauke Petry''' ({{IPA|de|ˈfʁaʊkə ˈpeːtʁiː|lang}}; {{nee|'''Marquardt'''}}; born 1 June 1975) is a German [[Far-right politics|far-right]] politician who chaired the [[Alternative for Germany]] (AfD) party from July 2015 to September 2017. A [[chemist]] by training and with a professional background as a [[businesswoman]], some political scientists described Petry as a representative of the [[National conservatism|national conservative]] wing of that party.<ref name="geiges"/><ref name="hentges"/><ref name="falter"/><ref name="decker"/>

Petry had formerly served as one of three party spokespersons from 2013 to 2015,<ref name="chairwoman">{{cite news|language= de|title= AfD: Lucke-Anhänger wollen neue Partei gründen|url= http://www.spiegel.de/politik/deutschland/afd-lucke-anhaenger-wollen-neue-partei-gruenden-a-1043320.html|access-date= 16 June 2016|work= [[Der Spiegel]]|date= 13 July 2015}}</ref> and became leader in 2015, displacing the party's founder [[Bernd Lucke]] after an internal power struggle; Lucke subsequently left the party and said it has "fallen irretrievably into the wrong hands" after Petry's election. Petry left the party in turn after stating it had become "anarchical" and unable to provide a "credible platform".<ref name="dw.com">{{Cite web|url=https://www.dw.com/en/german-election-the-day-after-angela-merkel-leaves-door-open-for-spd-coalition-talks-live-updates/a-40667843|title=+++ German election, the day after - live updates +++ – DW – 09/25/2017|website=dw.com}}</ref>

Petry is noted for her [[Opposition to immigration|anti-immigration]] and [[Islamophobia|anti-Islamic]] views, for her calls to ban [[minaret]]s,<ref name="telegraph">{{cite news|url= https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2016/05/01/far-right-afd-party-says-muslims-not-welcome-in-germany/|title= Far right AfD party says Muslims not welcome in Germany|newspaper= The Telegraph|date= May 2016|last1= Huggler|first1= Justin}}</ref> and for arguing that [[Law enforcement in Germany|German police forces]] should "use firearms if necessary" to prevent [[Illegal immigration to Europe|illegal border-crossings in Europe]].<ref>{{cite web|url= https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/german-police-should-shoot-refugees-says-german-party-leader-a6844611.html|title= Refugees should be shot 'if necessary', says party leader in Germany|website= [[Independent.co.uk]]|date= 31 January 2016}}</ref> She led the [[The Blue Party (Germany)|Blue Party]] until its dissolution in late 2019.<ref name=":0">{{Cite news|url=https://www.spiegel.de/politik/deutschland/frauke-petry-kuendigt-ende-ihrer-blauen-partei-an-a-1294984.html|title=Frauke Petry kündigt Ende ihrer "Blauen Partei" an – DER SPIEGEL – Politik|last=SPIEGEL|first=DER|date=5 November 2019|newspaper=Der Spiegel|language=de|access-date=22 March 2020}}</ref>

== Early life ==
Petry was born on 1 June 1975 to a chemist and an engineer in [[Dresden]] in what was then [[East Germany]]. She lived in [[Schwarzheide]], Brandenburg, near [[Saxony]] until the [[fall of the Berlin Wall]] in 1989, after which her family moved to [[Bergkamen]], in [[Westphalia]]. Petry took her first degree in chemistry at the [[University of Reading]], England, in 1998, before attending the [[University of Göttingen]], from where she gained a doctorate in 2004.<ref>{{cite book|last=Petry|first=Frauke|title=Charakterisierung eines neuen ATP-binding-cassette Transporters aus der ABCA-Subfamilie|url=http://webdoc.sub.gwdg.de/diss/2004/petry/petry.pdf|access-date=27 September 2013|year=2004|publisher=[[University of Göttingen]]|language=de|page=129}}{{Dead link|date=February 2026 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}(dissertation/curriculum vitae)</ref><ref name="lvz-74199" /> She was supported by a scholarship of the [[Studienstiftung]].<ref>{{Cite news|last=Jessen|first=Jens|date=9 July 2015|title=Stipendiaten {{!}} In bester Gesellschaft|url=https://www.zeit.de/2015/28/bernd-lucke-frauke-petry-studienstiftung|access-date=13 February 2021|newspaper=Die Zeit}}</ref>

== Political orientation ==
{{Conservatism in Germany|Politicians}}
Petry was described as a representative of the [[National conservatism|national-conservative]] wing of her party.<ref name="geiges">Lars Geiges, Stine Marg, Franz Walter: ''Pegida. Die schmutzige Seite der Zivilgesellschaft?'' Transcript, Bielefeld 2015, {{ISBN|978-3-8376-3192-0}}, S. 153.</ref><ref name="hentges">Gudrun Hentges: ''Sarrazins Erben: Ressentiments von PEGIDA und AfD finden sich schon beim Ex-Finanzsenator''. In: ''ROSALUX. Journal der [[Rosa-Luxemburg-Stiftung|Rosa Luxemburg Stiftung]]'', Ausgabe 1/2015, 20 f.</ref><ref name="falter">Kristina zur Mühlen: {{cite web | url=https://www.tagesschau.de/inland/afd-falter-101.html | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151031002343/http://www.tagesschau.de/inland/afd-falter-101.html |archive-date=31 October 2015 | title=Politologe zum Flügelkampf in der AfD: Machtkampf mindert die Wahlchancen |publisher=[[tagesschau24]]. tagesschau.de |type=Interview with Jürgen W. Falter |language=de |access-date=20 September 2017 |date=22 January 2015}}</ref><ref name="decker">Frank Decker: ''Alternative für Deutschland und Pegida. Die Ankunft des neuen Rechtspopulismus in der Bundesrepublik''. In: Frank Decker, Bernd Henningsen, Kjetil Jakobsen (Hrsg.): ''Rechtspopulismus und Rechtsextremismus in Europa. Die Herausforderung der Zivilgesellschaft durch alte Ideologien und neue Medien'' (= ''International Studies on Populism''. Bd. 2). Nomos, Baden-Baden 2015, {{ISBN|978-3-8487-1206-9}}, S. 75–90, hier: S. 80.</ref> To the contrary, political scientist [[Cas Mudde]] described her as a representative of the [[Far-right politics in Germany (1945–present)|far-right]] wing of her party.<ref>{{cite web |url= http://www.huffingtonpost.com/cas-mudde/one-alternative-for-germa_b_9453056.html|title= One Alternative for Germany or Many? The Mixed Message of the German State Elections |last1= Mudde |first1= Cas |date= 13 March 2016 |website=The Huffington Post }}</ref> Petry describes herself as national-conservative and supporting policies of "national self-determinism". ''[[Der Spiegel]]'' reports that her electoral success on 4 July 2015, which gave her the reins of leadership in the [[Alternative for Germany|AfD]] in preference to [[Bernd Lucke]], one of the party's founders, was made possible by the national-conservative wing of the party. Lucke's wing did not have the majority.<ref name="chairwoman"/>

On the subject of the [[political spectrum]], Petry has said, "Right and left are terms that haven't fitted for a long time".<ref name="KConnolly"/> Petry believes [[sharia]] is incompatible with the "democratic and liberal order of state"<ref name="interview">{{cite news|last=Sebastian|first=Tim|title=Transcript: Tim Sebastian interviews Frauke Petry|url=http://www.dw.com/en/transcript-tim-sebastian-interviews-frauke-petry/a-19152089|access-date=18 June 2016|work=[[Deutsche Welle]]|date=21 March 2016}}</ref> and has said that the majority within her AfD favors a liberal-conservative policy.<ref name = "mannheimerjanuary2016"/>

=== Border control ===
In January 2016, when a reporter from the regional newspaper ''Mannheimer Morgen'' asked her about European and German border policies, Petry answered that the [[Bundesgrenzschutz|German Border Police]] ({{lang|de|Bundesgrenzschutz}}) must do their jobs by "hindering illegal entry of refugees". The reporter followed up on her response, using the term {{lang|de|Schießbefehl}} which means "order to shoot". Petry stated that she did not use that term, going on to state that no policeman "wants to fire on a refugee and I don't want that either" but that the BGS must follow the law to maintain the [[External border of the European Union|integrity of European borders]].<ref name = "mannheimerjanuary2016">{{cite news|language=de|last1=Mack|first1=Steffen|last2=Serif|first2=Walter|title=Sie können es nicht lassen!|url=http://www.morgenweb.de/nachrichten/politik/sie-konnen-es-nicht-lassen-1.2620328|access-date=30 January 2016|work=[[:de:Mannheimer Morgen|Mannheimer Morgen]]|date=30 January 2016}}</ref> Afterwards, Petry made several attempts to justify these statements.<ref name="interview"/><ref name = "mannheimerjanuary2016"/>

=== Male circumcision ===
In a [[rough draft]] of its [[manifesto]], the [[Alternative for Germany|AfD]] had considered adopting a stance stating that [[Opposition to circumcision|male circumcision should be outlawed]], but Petry said in her interview with [[Tim Sebastian]] on 21 March 2016 that this language would not be in the final draft.<ref name="interview"/> The [[Central Council of Jews in Germany]] is also in an uproar over the question of [[religious circumcision]], stating that to give precedence to a child's [[self-determination]] over his parents' right of [[freedom of religion]] is "an unprecedented and dramatic intrusion on the right to self-determination of [[Confessional community|religious communities]]".<ref name= "newrules"/> This national dialogue is happening in the wake of a 2012 decision of a Higher Regional Court in [[Cologne]], which called the circumcision of a 4-year-old boy "[[Bodily integrity|bodily]] harm".<ref name= "newrules">{{cite news|title=Cutting Controversy: German Court Sets New Circumcision Rules|url=http://www.spiegel.de/international/germany/new-circumcision-ruling-requires-doctors-to-discuss-procedure-a-924984.html|access-date=14 June 2016|work=[[Der Spiegel]]|date=27 September 2013}}</ref>

=== Women in society ===
Petry does not believe mandatory quotas are the right way to give opportunities to women, nor does she believe they improve the chances of women having more leadership positions. She believes quotas make women unsure of whether a promotion would be made on the basis of qualifications.<ref>{{cite news|language=de|title=Die Frauenquote sei "völlig unausgegoren"|url=http://www.wiwo.de/politik/deutschland/alternative-fuer-deutschland-die-frauenquote-sei-voellig-unausgegoren/11041706.html|access-date=14 June 2016|work=[[Wirtschaftswoche]]|date=27 November 2014|archive-date=29 September 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170929032819/http://www.wiwo.de/politik/deutschland/alternative-fuer-deutschland-die-frauenquote-sei-voellig-unausgegoren/11041706.html|url-status=dead}}</ref>

Regarding the issue of [[burqa]]s, Petry believes it should not be compulsory for women to dress in such a manner. She has said that in schools "this sort of religious costume should not be worn".<ref name="interview"/>

=== Migration ===
On the issue of [[international migration]], Petry is of the view that, "We [Germany and the rest of Europe] have to decide what sort of migration we want to accept".<ref name="interview"/> She has said, "Deciding about who's migrating and who's not, who's going to be part of a new country is, in the end, a question of borders, whether you see them, or whether you don't. When I go to France, I don't see the border, but I know it's there and I accept it, be it in terms of speed limits, or be it in terms of laws and legislation".<ref name="interview"/>

==Resignation from AfD==
In April 2017, Petry stepped down as AfD's candidate for chancellor due to reports that she wanted to change the party's policies to appeal to more moderate voters like the [[Sweden Democrats]].<ref name="tele">{{cite news|last1=Huggler|first1=Justin|title=German far-right leader stuns party by quitting chancellor race|url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2017/04/21/german-far-right-leader-stunsparty-quitting-chancellor-race|website=The Telegraph|date=21 April 2017|access-date=27 April 2017}}</ref> This came after she had frequently criticised [[Björn Höcke]], one of the founders of AfD,<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.zeit.de/amp/politik/deutschland/2016-02/bjoern-hoecke-afd-rechtspopulismus-portraet|title=Björn Höcke: Mein Mitschüler, der rechte Agitator|last=Polke-Majewski|first=Karsten|date=18 February 2016|work=Die Zeit|access-date=19 April 2017|archive-date=31 May web|url=http://www.tlz.de/web/zgt/suche/detail/-/specific/Landtagswahl-2014-Welche-Koalitionen-sind-in-Thueringen-moeglich-179394471|archive-url=https://archive.today/20140903205616/http://www.tlz.de/web/zgt/suche/detail/-/specific/Landtagswahl-2014-Welche-Koalitionen-sind-in-Thueringen-moeglich-179394471|url-status=dead|archive-date=3 September 2014|title=Landtagswahl 2014: Welche Koalitionen sind in Thüringen möglich?"|date=16 July 2014|work=[[Thüringische Landeszeitung]]}}</ref><ref>{{cite 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304100830/http://afd-thueringen.de/vorstand/|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.spiegel.de/politik/deutschland/thueringen-immunitaet-von-afd-fraktionschef-hoecke-aufgehoben-a-1042010.html|title=Thüringen: Ausschuss hebt Immunität von AfD-Fraktionschef Höcke auf|date=3 July 2015|work=[[Der Spiegel]]|access-date=19 April 2017|archive-date=19 April 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230419175521/https://www.spiegel.de/politik/deutschland/thueringen-immunitaet-von-afd-fraktionschef-hoecke-aufgehoben-a-1042010.html|url-status=live}}</ref> due to a speech that he held in Dresden in which, referring to the [[Memorial to the Murdered Jews of Europe]], he stated that "we Germans are the only people in the world who have planted a memorial of shame in the heart of their capital",<ref name="FAZ-2017">{{cite news|url=https://www.faz.net/aktuell/politik/inland/afd-geht-nach-umstrittener-rede-auf-distanz-zu-hoecke-14686499.html|title=AfD-Mann Höcke löst mit Kritik an Holocaust-Gedenken Empörung aus|date=18 January 2017|language=de|work=[[Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung]]|access-date=2 June 2020|archive-date=11 November 2020|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201111170720/https://www.faz.net/aktuell/politik/inland/afd-geht-nach-umstrittener-rede-auf-distanz-zu-hoecke-14686499.html|url-status=live}}</ref> and suggested that Germans "need to make a 180 degree change in their politics of commemoration".<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.welt.de/politik/deutschland/article161286915/Was-Hoecke-mit-der-Denkmal-der-Schande-Rede-bezweckt.html|title=Was Höcke mit der "Denkmal der Schande"-Rede bezweckt|date=19 January 2017|language=de|author=Matthias Kamann|work=[[Die Welt]]|access-date=19 April 2017|archive-date=23 October 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231023151201/https://www.welt.de/politik/deutschland/article161286915/Was-Hoecke-mit-der-Denkmal-der-Schande-Rede-bezweckt.html|url-status=live}}</ref> The speech was widely criticized as [[Antisemitism in 21st century Germany|antisemitic]], among others by Jewish leaders in Germany.<ref name="FAZ-2017" /><ref>{{cite web|url=https://jungefreiheit.de/politik/deutschland/2017/petry-hoecke-ist-eine-belastung-fuer-die-partei/|title=AfD-Chefin Petry: "Höcke ist eine Belastung für die Partei"|date=18 January 2017|language=de|work=Junge Freiheit|access-date=19 April 2017|archive-date=4 June 2023|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230604090955/https://jungefreiheit.de/politik/deutschland/2017/petry-hoecke-ist-eine-belastung-fuer-die-partei/|url-status=live}}</ref> Petry backed attempts to expel Höcke from AfD as the party chairwoman, describing him as a "burden to the party",<ref name="FAZ-2017" /> but could not prevail in a power struggle with her party rivals [[Jörg Meuthen]]<ref name="tele"/> and [[Alexander Gauland]],<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.welt.de/politik/deutschland/article167328955/Frauke-Petry-bezichtigt-Gauland-und-Meuthen-der-Luege.html |title=Frauke Petry bezichtigt Gauland und Meuthen der Lüge |trans-title=Frauke Petry accuses Gauland and Meuthen of lying |work=[[Die Welt]] |date=2 August 2017 |language=de |access-date=6 May 2025}}</ref> who accused her of splitting party ranks.<ref name="dw_20170709"/> Her leadership style was seen by observers as having been high-handed and thus having alienated a number of party members.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.bpb.de/themen/parteien/parteien-in-deutschland/afd/273130/etappen-der-parteigeschichte-der-afd/ |title=Etappen der Parteigeschichte der AfD |trans-title=Stages of the party history of the AfD |first=Frank |last=Decker |work=[[Federal Agency for Civic Education|bpb]] |date=2 December 2022 |language=de |access-date=6 May 2025}}</ref> Despite the internal strife, her party voted to allow her to run for a seat in the [[Bundestag (Germany)|German parliament]] in the [[2017 German federal election|September 2017 elections]].<ref name="dw_20170709">{{cite web |url=http://www.dw.com/en/alternative-for-germanys-frauke-petry-survives-attempted-in-party-putsch/a-39619218 |title=Alternative for Germany's Frauke Petry survives attempted in-party putsch| first=David |last=Martin |work=[[Deutsche Welle]] via [[Deutsche Presse-Agentur|dpa]] |date=9 September 2017 |access-date=6 May 2025}}</ref>

One day after election night in which Petry was elected to the Bundestag by direct mandate, she left an AfD press conference saying that she won't join the party's parliamentary group in the Bundestag because the party became too "anarchical" and "could not offer a credible platform". [[Alice Weidel]], the AfD's frontrunner, demanded her resignation from the party.<ref name="dw.com"/> Following this, Petry said that she would join the [[Bundestag]] as an [[independent politician]].<ref name="Connolly">[https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/sep/25/afd-leader-frauke-petry-quits-party-german-election-breakthrough AfD leader quits party caucus hours after German election breakthrough], The Guardian</ref> She resigned from the party and all offices on 29 September 2017.<ref>{{Cite news|url=http://www.spiegel.de/politik/deutschland/afd-frauke-petry-ist-aus-der-partei-ausgetreten-a-1170533.html|title=Petry offiziell ausgetreten: AfD bangt um ihre Mitte|last=Weiland|first=Severin|date=29 September 2017|work=Spiegel Online|access-date=29 September 2017}}</ref> She was subsequently charged with perjury for allegedly lying under oath about her former party's finances.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2017/10/04/former-afd-leader-frauke-petry-faces-jail-charged-perjury/|title = Former AfD leader Frauke Petry could face jail after being charged with perjury|newspaper = The Telegraph|date = 4 October 2017|last1 = Huggler|first1 = Justin}}</ref> She was convicted and sentenced to a fine of 6,000 euros. In 2020, the [[Federal Court of Justice]] overturned the conviction on the grounds that the law on perjury did not apply to the context in which she made the false statements.<ref>{{cite news |title=Bundesgerichtshof spricht Frauke Petry in Falscheid-Verfahren frei |date=6 May 2020 |url=https://www.dw.com/de/bundesgerichtshof-spricht-frauke-petry-in-falscheid-verfahren-frei/a-53351748 |trans-title=Federal Court of Justice acquits Frauke Petry in perjury proceedings |access-date=20 March 2021 |work=[[Deutsche Welle]] |language=de-DE}}</ref>

On 12 October 2017, Petry announced that she would form a new party, called the [[The Blue Party (Germany)|Blue Party]], which would provide a "reasonable conservative" agenda and seek to replicate the success of the [[Christian Social Union in Bavaria]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.reuters.com/article/us-germany-politics-afd/former-leader-of-germanys-far-right-kicks-off-new-blue-party-idUSKBN1CH315|title=Former leader of Germany's far-right kicks off new 'Blue Party'|date=12 October 2017|work=Reuters|access-date=12 October 2017}}</ref> In late 2019, that party was dissolved.<ref name=":0" />

Petry made a reappearance in public during an April 2021 interview with [[Kurt Krömer]] in which she spoke about the [[Alternative for Germany donation scandal]]. She revealed that she would be writing a book about her time as AfD leader.<ref>{{cite web|access-date=2021-06-14|title=Chez Krömer – Frauke Petry (S04/E03)|url=https://www.ardmediathek.de/video/chez-kroemer/chez-kroemer-oder-frauke-petry-s04-e03/rbb-fernsehen/Y3JpZDovL3JiYi1vbmxpbmUuZGUvY2hlei1rcm9lbWVyLzIwMjEtMDQtMDZUMjI6MTU6MDBfZjcxZDRmZWYtZGU3MS00YzI4LWIzYjMtNGVlYWJlZTg2ODFmL2NoZXota3JvZW1lci1mcmF1a2UtcGV0cnktcmJiLWZlcm5zZWhlbg/|website=ARD-Mediathek}}<!-- auto-translated by Module:CS1 translator --></ref><ref>{{cite web|access-date=2021-06-14|author=Marcel Görmann|date=2021-04-09|title=AfD: "Unangenehm" – Zuschauer nach Auftritt von Ex-Parteichefin Frauke Petry bei Krömer frustriert|url=https://www.derwesten.de/politik/afd-frauke-petry-kurt-kroemer-rbb-bundestag-mediathek-twitter-zuschauer-reaktionen-id231972981.html|website=DerWesten}}<!-- auto-translated by Module:CS1 translator --></ref> The book was subsequently published as ''Requiem for the AfD'' in which Petry argued the party had become a "chaotic protest party" no longer interested in governing after she resigned as leader and accused politicians within the party of being blackmailed into accepting undeclared donations.<ref name="faz21">Markus Wehner: [https://www.faz.net/aktuell/politik/inland/frauke-petrys-abrechnung-mit-der-afd-in-ihrem-buch-17396823.html ''Frauke Petry rechnet mit der AfD ab.''] www.faz.net, 18. Juni 2021.</ref>

==Personal life==
In 2007, Petry founded her own business, ''PURinvent'', a [[Leipzig]]-based manufacturer of [[polyurethane]] tire fill products.<ref name="lvz-74199" /> She received the [[Order of Merit of the Federal Republic of Germany#Classes|Medal of the Order of Merit]] in 2012.<ref name="lvz-158032" /><ref>{{cite web|title=Ordensverleihung zum Tag der Deutschen Einheit|url=http://www.bundespraesident.de/SharedDocs/Berichte/DE/Joachim-Gauck/2012/10/121004-Verdienstorden-Tag-der-Deutschen-Einheit.html|publisher=[[Bundespräsidialamt]]|date=4 October 2012|access-date=27 September 2013|language=de}}</ref>
 
Petry separated from her husband, Sven Petry, a [[Lutheranism|Lutheran]] [[pastor]],<ref name="KConnolly"/> in October 2015, stating that this was by mutual consent and that the two remained friends and would continue to share in the upbringing of their four children.<ref>{{cite news|language=de|title=AfD-Chefin Petry trennt sich von ihrem Ehemann|url=http://www.sz-online.de/sachsen/afd-chefin-petry-trennt-sich-von-ihrem-ehemann-3217629.html|access-date=15 June 2016|work=[[Sächsische Zeitung]]|date=7 October 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170824051311/http://www.sz-online.de/sachsen/afd-chefin-petry-trennt-sich-von-ihrem-ehemann-3217629.html|archive-date=24 August 2017|url-status=dead}}</ref> Frauke Petry also revealed that "much more than just friendly feelings" had developed between her and [[Marcus Pretzell]], a fellow AfD party member.<ref name="Teffer">{{cite web|url=https://euobserver.com/political/130891 |title=Germany's anti-euro party which became two|author=Peter Teffer|date=30 October 2015|publisher=[[EUobserver]]|access-date=23 March 2016}}</ref> At about the same time, it was announced that Sven Petry had joined the [[Christian Democratic Union of Germany|CDU]].<ref name="Decker">{{cite web | last=Decker | first=Markus | title=Sven Petry geht zur CDU | publisher=[[Frankfurter Rundschau]] | date=12 January 2019 | url=https://www.fr.de/politik/sven-petry-geht-11145382.html | language=de | access-date=10 September 2026}}</ref><ref name="KConnolly">{{cite news|url=https://www.theguardian.com/world/2016/feb/07/frauke-petry-smiling-face-resurgent-right |title=Frauke Petry: Smiling face of Germany's resurgent right|author=Kate Connolly|date=7 February 2016|newspaper=[[The Observer]]|access-date=7 February 2016}}</ref> In December 2016, Petry married Pretzell, by then her domestic partner.<ref>{{cite news|language=de|last1=Amann|first1=Melanie|last2=Weiland|first2=Severin|title=Angebliches Beratungsangebot: Die AfD, der Journalist und ein heikler Vorwurf|url=http://www.spiegel.de/politik/deutschland/afd-welt-reporter-lachmann-wehrt-sich-gegen-pretzell-a-1076874.html|access-date=15 June 2016|work=[[Der Spiegel]]|date=12 February 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|title=Frauke Petry heiratet ein zweites Mal|periodical=[[Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung#FAZ.NET|FAZ.net]]|url=https://www.faz.net/1.4588112|access-date=22 December 2016|last=Justus Bender|date=22 December 2016|language=de}}</ref> Having had two further children with Pretzell,<ref>[https://www.merkur.de/politik/frauke-petry-ehemann-karriere-kinder-was-macht-sie-nach-afd-zr-12948847.html Frauke Petry: Ehemann, Karriere, Kinder – Was macht sie nach der AfD?], merkur.de, 2 September 2019, accessed 27 June 2021 (in German)</ref> Petry now has six altogether and lives in [[Frohburg|Tautenhain]], Saxony.<ref name="lvz-74199" /><ref name="lvz-158032" />

Petry is a member of the [[Evangelical-Lutheran Church of Saxony]], a member church of the [[Evangelical Church in Germany]] (EKD). She criticizes many stances of the EKD, which historically holds a largely [[Liberal Christianity|liberal]] [[Mainline Protestantism|Protestant]] stance, claiming it follows "only its own interests" regarding immigration. In 2016 she advocated its cooperation with AfD in order to defend the "European Christian values of the West".<ref name="evangelisch-in-hennef.de">{{cite web|url=http://evangelisch-in-hennef.de/wie-christlich-ist-die-afd/|title=Wie christlich ist die AfD? – Evangelische Kirchengemeinde Hennef|date=18 April 2016}}</ref>
